interpretation.selection: Each corrected pair matched to the published long-track RX0/RX1 observation IDs by exact tracking-CFO fields.
interpretation.double_differences: Legacy asynchronous-centroid double_differences are diagnostic only and are not interpreted as geometric phase.
interpretation.second_pair: phase_blind_pair_count > 1 flags a possible same-visit second shared source for follow-up; it does not itself establish matched-pilot DD.
